message: The other night, I caught my kids trying to roast marshmallows over the kitchen stove—talk about a parenting moment! After a quick chat about fire safety and our escape plan, we turned it into a fun family fire drill. Kids got to test the smoke alarm and practice getting out quickly, all while giggling. It’s funny how these moments can turn into valuable lessons. How do you keep your family safe while having fun? 🔥
